title: Uyir
overview: Sundar lives with his brother's family but is unaware that his sister-in-law Arundathi lusts for him. After his brother's suicide, Sundar is forced to look after Arundathi and her children.

songs.title: Uyir
songs.singers: GKB, Dharshan Ravi Kumar, G.V. Prakash Kumar, Saindhavi
